Er...what about the errata on Freak Drive ???

Freak Drive
Is played at the end of an action, but still during the action. It
cannot be played on an action that was made unpreventable by
Concoction of Vitality, for example. [LSJ 19981028]

so can you play Freak Drive on a succesful action made unblockable
byday operation/daring the dawn, etc ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.
See Concoction of Vitality for contrast.
